correctness.rationale: For odd k>=3 and n>=k, a,b,c are three consecutive centered k-gonal values with b-a=kn,c-b=k(n+1), c-a=k(2n+1). Pairwise gcd(a,b),gcd(b,c)<=2 and gcd(a,c)=d=gcd(2n+1,3k+8), odd. Classical three-generator gluing criterion for symmetric semigroups reduces symmetry to a representability condition for some pair; inequalities modulo k eliminate pairs (a,b),(b,c). Bounds on d versus a/n and c/(n+1) force, for (a,c), coefficient count exactly d, hence v=dn/(2n+1) integer; gcd(n,2n+1)=1 forces 2n+1|d, so 2n+1=3k+8 and n=(3k+7)/2. The k=3 small-index boundary separately handled using d|17. Conversely when N=K, (n+1)a+n c=K b and gcd(K,b)=1 give gluing and symmetry. Frobenius formula F=ac/K-a-c+(K-1)b expands to displayed quintic; genus (F+1)/2. Independent exact integer Watanabe/gluing checks cover 855 (odd k, n) pairs k=3..39,n=k..k+44, and independent Apéry computations confirm F/g for k=3,5,7,9. No inference from finite search to all k.
